title: Recompute readiness from the full dependency graph after adding blockers
description: Audit finding F-007: adding a blocker derives readiness from only the new blocker instead of the full dependency set.
acceptanceCriteria: Adding a blocker recomputes readiness against all current dependencies, not just the newly added blocker.
Work blocked by an existing open dependency stays blocked when a closed dependency is added.
Regression coverage proves add and remove paths keep readiness consistent.
closedReason: Implemented and verified in sprint bw_work_30c5438d99da6ce6.
